title: Chapter 284 Wars Break Out Everywhere, Flames Rage
content:
Chapter 284 Wars Break Out Everywhere, Flames Rage

Just when the battle of Nanshanji started.

The Dahuai area was full of smoke, like hell on earth.

Outside Tianba Town, Ye Tianba was covered in blood, and the tip of his spear was cut off by a skeleton leader on the opposite side.

The soldiers behind him also suffered heavy casualties.

The sky was overcast, and the deathly aura was rampant on the battlefield.

Outside the city wall of Tianba Town, corpses were everywhere, blood flowed like a river, and the battlefield full of smoke was full of broken limbs.

Some soldiers struggled to support their bodies with weapons and tried to stay standing, but their eyes were full of determination.

They fought from morning to afternoon for a full seven hours.

The endless stream of skeleton soldiers continued to consume the manpower of Tianba Town.

It was not that they were not brave in fighting, but there were too many enemies. Although there were not many high-level skeleton soldiers, the low-level ones were overwhelming.

Ye Tianba looked haggard and very sad in his heart.

"Is it really impossible to save it?"

He sighed to the sky, and walked towards the village with the remaining soldiers.

There, a part of the city wall had collapsed, otherwise it could have held out for a while.

Now, they can only abandon the town and leave.

Changping County.

Lin Xiaodong was wearing armor, wearing a hooded helmet, and holding a sword.

On the city gate tower, looking up, the mountains and plains were full of skeleton beasts and soldiers, surrounding Changping County.

As if to accumulate more strength, they did not rashly launch an attack.

They just collided tentatively a few times, and then stopped.

Lin Xiaodong knew that this was just the calm before the storm.

Xiaochi Town, Dongshi Town, Baiyang Town, Qingxi Town, Feishui Town, Zouma Town, Luohe County, Xilin County...

It was the same.

Wolf smoke rose everywhere, and there was wailing everywhere...

Under the wall of Nanshanji, Wang Shuo turned around and looked at the Demon Wolf King who was close at hand.

Seeing the other party chasing him, Wang Shuo was not afraid, but smiled.

Because the current position was already within the attack range of the bronze crossbow cart.

The Demon Wolf King was very agile, and he had to control it if he wanted the bronze spear to hit him.

In order to confuse the Demon Wolf King, Wang Shuo used the skill "Multiplication".

His body immediately became larger and transformed into a 5-meter-tall giant.

Although his attributes and strength did not change, his own aura was enhanced by one level.

He was originally only a mid-level general, but he immediately transformed into a high-level general.

And his body suddenly became larger, which surprised the Demon Wolf King.

Wang Shuo seized the opportunity and used the control skill combo.

"Iron Chain Binding" + "Abyss Swamp".

Because the Demon Wolf King's attributes were too strong, the iron chain binding was only controlled for less than 1 second.

But the abyss swamp had been released, and a huge swamp appeared around him.

Wang Shuo's face was happy.

"Good."

Wang Shuo shouted.

Wang Shuo gave the previously purchased "root entanglement" skill to Goode.

As a person using bows and arrows, it is still very dangerous to use it to distance yourself from the enemy without a control skill.

Goode immediately understood and immediately added a "root entanglement".

The Demon Wolf King was immediately entangled by the roots extending from the void.

"2 seconds."

Goode got the control time and shouted immediately.

Wang Shuo was delighted, it was enough.

Li Jianguo did not wait for Wang Shuo's order, and the bronze crossbow cart that had been prepared long ago pulled open the linen covering it, revealing the sharp spear tip.

The spear tip exuded a cold light, which made people feel afraid.

"Release."

More than 30 bronze spears rushed out, and the strong dangerous aura made the Demon Wolf King struggle violently.
